Oversee Group Effort Initiative interns each semester, leading recruitment, workload management, task assignment, timesheet and performance‑evaluation approvals, and ensuring an immersive internship experience. Build new and strengthen existing relationships with company partners across the country and globally to source job, mentorship, and event opportunities for participants. Represent Group Effort at events and meetings with potential corporate, production, and education partners, serving as a key ambassador for the organization. Work alongside Group Effort Initiative leadership to conduct data‑driven evaluations of the organization’s corporate placement, mentorship, mid‑level development, and educational programming, ensuring insights are used to improve participant outcomes and strengthen employer partnerships. Prepare external and internal materials on program accomplishments.  Work day-of at Group Effort Initiative events and assist with coordination of some Group Effort Initiative events. Experience with and understanding of the entertainment industry Enthusiasm, flexibility, integrity, professional demeanor, creativity and the willingness to assume challenges and increased responsibility.  Ability to coordinate multiple projects with different timelines simultaneously and successfully.   Proactive problem-solving.  A clear sense of urgency, and ability to complete tasks accurately and efficiently with extreme attention to detail.  Excellent communication skills, both verbally and written.  Ability to engage professionally and work well with executives, candidates, external partners, and stakeholders at all levels.  Passion for making meaningful, sustainable change in the entertainment industry regarding inclusion and access.  Must be a self-starter with a strong work ethic and ability to work independently and as part of a team. A proactive, forward thinking and solution-oriented approach to work   Experience evaluating and interviewing talent for job opportunities.
